name: Kee Ming Group Berhad
overview: Kee Ming Group Berhad 于2026年2月12日在ACE Market上市，首次公开募股（IPO）涉及82,875,000股普通股。公司业务涵盖电气工程、机械工程、消防系统及维护维修服务，但2026年公告中未披露各业务板块的具体扩张、缩减或合约动态。
overview_en: Kee Ming Group Berhad was listed on the ACE Market on 12 February 2026, with an initial public offering (IPO) of 82,875,000 ordinary shares. The company's business covers electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, fire protection systems, and maintenance and repair services, but the 2026 announcements do not disclose specific expansion, reduction, or contract developments for each business segment.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司于2026年2月12日在ACE Market上市，并披露了与关联方的经常性关联交易。
segments.note_en: The company was listed on the ACE Market on 12 February 2026 and disclosed recurrent related party transactions.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司Kee Ming Electrical Sdn. Bhd.与关联公司Atlantic Blue Sdn. Bhd.在正常业务过程中进行经常性关联交易，自2026年2月12日上市至2026年6月5日，交易总额超过100万令吉及1.0%的百分比比率。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Kee Ming Electrical Sdn. Bhd. entered into recurrent related party transactions with Atlantic Blue Sdn. Bhd., a connected company, in the ordinary course of business;

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING ("IPO") OF 82,875,000 ORDINARY SHARES IN KEE MING GROUP BERHAD ("KEE MING" OR "COMPANY") ("SHARES") COMPRISING PUBLI
actions.text: 公司进行首次公开募股（IPO），涉及82,875,000股普通股，包括公开发行66,625,000股新股和献售16,250,000股现有股份，并于2026年2月12日在ACE Market上市。
actions.text_en: The company conducted an initial public offering (IPO) of 82,875,000 ordinary shares, comprising a public issue of 66,625,000 new shares and an offer for sale of 16,250,000 existing shares, and was listed on the ACE Market on 12 February 2026.
